page.layout: One page of text, one column. Running head "LIBER II" at top centre, page number "157" at top right. No margin notes. Page opens with continuation of text from previous page. Last word "Fiat" set right-aligned at the foot of the text block. No catchword or signature.

main_text.p: Responsio specialis ad singula: formentur inte-gri syllogismi, ut melius appareat solutionum veritas.
AD PRIMUM absurdum. In dubium vocari totam Christianam religionem & fidem: Pro-batio adversarii Thesi 499. quia falsitatis argua-tur tota Scriptura.
(Fiat syllogismus: Falsitatis arguere totam Scripturam est totam religionem & fidem in dubium vocare.
Negare absolutam redemtionem omnium etiam infidelium est falsitatis arguere totam Scripturam. Ergo, &c.)
Respon. i. negatione minoris. Rationes breviter petantur ex confirmatione.
1. quia Scriptura beneficia mortis Christi vē-dicat solis credentibus. Ioh.3.
2. Infideles canes & porcos diserte excludit, Ioh.3. Matth.7.
3. Vniversalitas promissionum Evangelii ad credentes pertinet. Act.10. vox omnium prophe-tarum, &c. quod conditio fidei & poenitentiae expressa vel subintellecta ostendit.
II. per inversionem. Adversarii hypothesis evertit religionem:
Ratio: quia canes & porcos in sinum & gratiam Dei collocando, atheismo portam aperit.
AD SECUNDUM absurdum. Scripturam transformari in mendacissimum Alcoranum. Probatio adversarii: Thes. 276. 277.&c. quia sit Mahometica doctrina, Deum non velle omnes homines salvos facere & fieri.

page.notes: Small-caps lead-ins (AD PRIMUM, AD SECUNDUM) and the italic run-ins are set in the printed type as shown. The line-end hyphens in "Pro-batio", "argua-tur", "inte-gri", "vē-dicat" and "prophe-tarum" are printed and kept. "vē-dicat": the macron over e is doubtful and marked by the printer's abbreviation, so the reading "vendicat" is uncertain. "sinum" is read from a long-s form that could also be "finum".
